questions.title: Running total order
questions.q: These lines add up five marks typed in at the keyboard and display the total. Put them in the correct order.
questions.fb: The total must be set to 0 before the loop, so each mark can be added to it inside the loop. The total is displayed after the loop has finished.

questions.title: Doubling loop
questions.q:
What does this program display?

SET x TO 3
FOR counter FROM 1 TO 4 DO
   SET x TO x * 2
END FOR
SEND x TO DISPLAY
questions.fb: x starts at 3 and is doubled four times: 6, 12, 24, 48.

questions.title: Joining strings
questions.q:
What does this program display?

SET town TO "Fort"
SET place TO "William"
SEND town & " " & place TO DISPLAY
questions.fb: The & operator joins strings together (concatenation). The string in the middle is a single space.

opts.fb: Correct.
There is a space between the two names: the middle string is a space.
& is the joining operator. It is not displayed.
Nothing is added up: the strings are joined and the operator is not displayed.

questions.title: Postcode type
questions.q: A program stores a postcode such as PH33 6AB. What data type should be used? Type one word.
questions.fb: A postcode mixes letters, digits and a space, and nobody does arithmetic with it, so it is a string.

questions.title: Extreme test data
questions.q: A program accepts a pupil's age from 12 to 18 inclusive. Select ALL the extreme test data values.
questions.fb: Extreme data is at the very edge of what is allowed: the lowest and highest valid values. 15 is normal data. 11 and 19 are outside the range, so they are exceptional.

opts.fb: Correct.
Correct.
15 is in the middle of the range: it is normal data.
11 is just outside the range. That is exceptional data, not extreme data.
19 is just outside the range. That is exceptional data, not extreme data.

questions.title: Syntax errors
questions.q: A syntax error is found while the program is running, because the program does the wrong thing.
questions.fb: A syntax error breaks the rules of the language, so it is found as the code is translated. A program that runs but gives the wrong result has a logic error.

opts.fb: A syntax error is a mistake in the rules of the language, found when the code is translated. Wrong results from a program that runs are a logic error.
Correct.

questions.title: Denary to binary
questions.q: Convert the denary number 37 to binary. Type the digits only.

questions.title: Vector or bitmap
questions.q: A club wants a logo that can be enlarged for a banner without losing quality. Which type of graphic should it use?
questions.fb: A vector graphic is stored as objects with attributes, so the computer redraws it at any size. A bit-mapped graphic is a grid of pixels and loses quality when enlarged.

opts.fb: Correct.
Enlarging a bit-mapped graphic stretches its pixels, so it looks blocky.

questions.title: Inside the processor
questions.q: Match each part of the computer to its job.
questions.fb: The control unit organises the fetch-execute cycle, and the ALU does the arithmetic and logic. The address bus carries the memory location, and the data bus carries the contents.
pairs: controls the transfer of instructions and data
carries the location of the memory being used
carries the contents of a memory location

questions.title: Compiler clues
questions.q: A company sells a finished game. The player's computer must run it without needing the programmer's source code. Which translator was used?
questions.fb: A compiler translates the whole program to machine code in advance, so only the translated program needs to be supplied. An interpreter translates and runs one line at a time and needs the source code each time it runs.

opts.fb: Correct.
An interpreter translates the source code each time it runs, so the source would have to be supplied.

questions.title: Firewall
questions.q: What is the main job of a firewall?
questions.fb: A firewall checks the data entering and leaving a network and blocks what is not allowed. Encryption, not a firewall, scrambles data so it cannot be read if it is intercepted.

opts.h: To block unauthorised connections to and from a network
opts.fb: Correct.

opts.h: To scramble data so it cannot be read if intercepted
opts.fb: That describes encryption.

opts.h: To make the computer run faster
opts.fb: A firewall is a security measure, not a speed-up.

questions.title: Primary key
questions.q: What is the job of a primary key in a table?
questions.fb: A primary key is a field whose value is different for every record, so each record can be found exactly.

opts.fb: Correct.

opts.h: It links to a field in another table
opts.fb: That describes a foreign key.

opts.h: It is the first field in the table
opts.fb: Its position does not matter: it is the uniqueness that makes it a key.

questions.title: Count the records
questions.q:
This table is called ferry.

routepassengers
Oban120
Mull45
Skye80
Islay30
Arran95
Barra60

How many records does this statement return?

SELECT route
FROM ferry
WHERE passengers > 50
AND passengers < 100
questions.fb: The passengers must be above 50 and below 100: that is Skye (80), Arran (95) and Barra (60), so 3 records. Oban (120) is too high, and Mull (45) and Islay (30) are too low.

questions.title: Complete the update
questions.q:
A pupil moves house. Choose the missing word to change only the record where pupilID is 7.

UPDATE pupil
SET town = "Perth"
[[1]] pupilID = 7
questions.fb: WHERE picks which records change. Without it, every record in the table would be updated.

questions.title: Relative address
questions.q: A page in the folder site shows a picture stored in site/images. Which address is a relative address?
questions.fb: A relative address gives the path from the current page. An absolute address gives the full web address, starting with https://.

opts.fb: Correct.
This is a full web address, so it is absolute.

questions.title: Mouse events
questions.q: The JavaScript event onmouseover runs when the mouse pointer moves onto an element.
questions.fb: onmouseover runs when the pointer moves onto an element, and onmouseout when it moves off.

opts.fb: Correct.
onmouseover is the event for the pointer moving onto an element.

questions.title: Transparent image
questions.q: A web page needs a logo with a transparent background that does not lose quality when compressed. Which format is best?
questions.fb: PNG supports transparency and its compression keeps all the detail. JPEG does not support transparency. GIF does, but only has 256 colours.

opts.fb: Correct.
JPEG does not support transparency.
GIF supports transparency, but only 256 colours, so a detailed logo would lose quality.
